name: Balasa Floating Chat Button
author: balasanour

sections.description:
Balasa Floating Chat Button adds a clean, floating button to every page of your website. When a visitor taps it, a WhatsApp conversation opens with your number and an optional pre-filled message, so they can reach you in one tap.

No coding needed. Just enter your number in the settings and you are done.

Features

  • Floating chat button on every page
  • Set your own number (with country code)
  • Optional pre-filled greeting message
  • Lightweight and fast, no external libraries
  • Works on mobile and desktop
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin through Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin, or copy the balasa-floating-chat-button folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > Balasa Floating Chat Button and enter your number (with country code, digits only, e.g. 201001234567).
  4. Optionally add a pre-filled message.
  5. Save. The button now appears on your site.
sections.faq:
What format should the number be in?

Use the full international number with country code, digits only, no plus sign or spaces. Example: 201001234567.

Does it work on mobile?

Yes. On phones it opens the WhatsApp app. On desktop it opens WhatsApp Web.

Can I change the pre-filled message?

Yes, in Settings > Balasa Floating Chat Button there is a field for the message that appears when the chat opens.
